elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: HDI has no express duty to defend, and the Company's affiliates are not covered.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: HDI indemnifies the Company against specified third-party claims, but not the Company's affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: HDI indemnifies claims alleging that the Site or HDI's services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: No indemnity applies to HDI's breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: No indemnity applies to a data breach caused by HDI.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: No indemnity applies to HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no claim-notice requirement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: The clause does not allocate control of the defence.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no cooperation requirement.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: The rendered language imposes no indemnity obligation on the Company, so no Customer indemnity extends beyond these permitted subjects.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: HDI indemnifies the Company against third-party claims alleging that the Site or HDI's services infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: The indemnity excludes claims to the extent arising from modifications made by the Company.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: The indemnity excludes claims arising from combination of the Site with items not supplied by HDI.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: The indemnity excludes claims arising from the Company's specifications.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: HDI must procure continued use or modify or replace the affected item so it is non-infringing.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: If none of those remedies is reasonably available, HDI must refund fees paid for the affected item.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c) liability is capped at three times the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim.
